name: get_news_sentiment
description: Fetches the latest 5 news articles and AI-scored sentiment for a stock ticker from Alpha Vantage. Returns article title, source, publication time, URL, and per-ticker sentiment label (Bearish / Somewhat-Bearish / Neutral / Somewhat-Bullish / Bullish). Use for market sentiment analysis and news-driven investment signals. Requires ALPHA_VANTAGE_API_KEY.
